description_short: Mass-assign vehicles to logistics zones, Quick Repair, Unity Recover, Empty Cargo and more with an all-in-one multi-select tool.
description_long: Omni-Tool combines vehicle, logistics, building, and optional sandbox actions into one configurable multi-select toolbar tool and independent Omni-Belt. Fresh installs receive purpose-built Vehicle Tools and Building Tools profiles, plus a dormant non-cycling Terraforming profile when sandbox eligibility exists. Named profiles auto-save and support category visibility, enabled tools, colors, choices, ordering, and position. Shared tools carry stable primary and secondary category tags. Sandbox access uses a separate conditional global master switch. Opening Settings safely locks every world tool while leaving a dimmed Omni-Belt preview available, and restoring factory profiles requires two confirmations. Terrain Eraser offers a precise -10 to 0 range plus an expanded -50 to +50 option; Restore Terrain remains dormant, while Pause and Upgrade are removed.
